goal: Contain the synchronous legacy gear-stat endpoint with a one-iteration stat_snapshot_v1 execution flavor and process-global SimC concurrency one while preserving its response contract.
userValue: Existing clients keep receiving the same stat snapshot shape without each request launching a 1000-iteration or unbounded parallel SimC workload.
nonGoals: No new asynchronous stat snapshot endpoint
No database migration or new table
No stat snapshot Worker or systemd unit
No frontend cutover or state change
No public gear template policy change
No sync, write, backfill or cleanup change
No dependency installation or third-party download

mustChange: server/websim_payload.py execution flavor and gear-stat SimC limiter
tests/websim_payload_test.py lightweight profile, response compatibility and concurrency characterization
Phase 0C verification, runbook and release evidence
mustNotChange: standard profile and simulator submission flavor
sync, write, backfill and cleanup paths
evidenceRequired: red test proving legacy stat execution currently uses iterations=1000
red concurrency test proving no global one-permit wrapper exists
green stat_snapshot_v1, legacy response and standard-profile tests
complete Phase 0 backend, frontend and full verification profiles
local CR and git diff check
candidate legacy endpoint, live-module flavor and two-thread limiter smoke
timer backflow and runtime hash parity evidence

engineeringHealth.reason: The change is a narrow compatibility containment in a backend hotspot; it adds no route, schema or Worker and is protected by response characterization, default-flavor regression, concurrency proof, full verification, candidate smoke and code rollback.

acceptanceEvidence: candidate legacy stats, stat_snapshot_v1 and concurrency-one runtime smoke

decisionLog.decision: Keep the default standard_profile behavior unchanged and select stat_snapshot_v1 only inside the legacy gear-stat response builder.
Serialize only gear-stat SimC execution with one process-global permit until the Phase 5 asynchronous Worker replaces this synchronous path.
